options.description: Boolean/command-line flags for Caja startup behavior (only set to true if desired). All fields default to false unless specified otherwise.

options.browser.description: Open a browser window. Corresponds to --browser.

options.check.description: Perform quick self-check tests. Corresponds to -c/--check.

options.display.description: X display to use. Corresponds to --display=DISPLAY.

options.tabs.description: Open URIs in tabs. Corresponds to --tabs.

options.no_default_window.description: Only create windows for explicitly specified URIs. Corresponds to --no-default-window.

options.no_desktop.description: Do not manage the desktop. Corresponds to --no-desktop.

options.force_desktop.description: Manage the desktop regardless of preferences. Corresponds to --force-desktop.

options.version.description: Print version and exit. Corresponds to --version.

uris.description: List of URIs to open in Caja windows (e.g., ['file:///home/user', 'ftp://ftp.kernel.org/']).
